test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Given below are six sentences. A and F are the first and the last sentences. The rest of the sentences namely B, C, D and E are jumbled. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It was noon and by now the two bandits were very hungry.

B. Now the one who was guarding the treasure thought, “It is a pity that this treasure has to be divided between two.”

C. So they decided that one of them would stay near the treasure and guard it.

D. And the other one would go to the neighbouring village and buy some food.

E. The one who stayed back placed his sword near the treasure and kept guard while the other set off in the direction of the village.

F. “It would be so much simpler if I could take it all.”
solution:
The correct answer is '**ACDEBF**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sentence ‘C’** comes first as it is independent of any other sentence and introduces **when both of them decided to talk among themselves to quench the hunger**, So it will be put in the **first place**.
 
• **Sentence ‘D’** follows **‘C’** as it talks about **after the verdict, one stayed there near the treasury and the other went to a nearby village to buy some food**, and gives some information about the previous sentence, So it will be put in the **second place**.
 
• **Sentence ‘E’** follows **‘D’** as it states that, **one of the two stopped for protection by placing a sword near the treasure and the other left for the village**, as per mentioned in the given above sentence, So it will be put in the third place.
 
• **Sentence ‘B’** follows **‘E’** as it tells that, **the one who stood guarding the treasure thought, "It would be a pity to divide this treasure between two****"**, so **sentence B** is the concluding sentence. So it will be put in the fourth place.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that **the correct order** is ‘**ACDEBF**’.
 
• **Thus, the sequence becomes:**
 
 
• **​**A: It was noon and by now the two bandits were very hungry. (दोपहर हो चुकी थी और अब तक दोनों डाकू बहुत भूखे थे।)
 
• C: So they decided that one of them would stay near the treasure and guard it. (इसलिए उन्होंने फैसला किया कि उनमें से एक खजाने के पास रहेगा और उसकी रखवाली करेगा।)
 
• D: And the other one would go to the neighbouring village and buy some food. (और दूसरा पास के गाँव में जाकर कुछ खाना खरीदता।)
 
• E: The one who stayed back placed his sword near the treasure and kept guard while the other set off in the direction of the village. (जो पीछे रह गया, उसने अपनी तलवार खजाने के पास रख दी और पहरा दे दिया, जबकि दूसरा गाँव की ओर चल पड़ा।)
 
• B: Now the one who was guarding the treasure thought, “It is a pity that this treasure has to be divided between two.” (अब जो खजाने की रखवाली कर रहा था, उसने सोचा, "यह अफ़सोस की बात है कि इस खजाने को दो के बीच विभाजित करना पड़ रहा है।")
 
• F: “It would be so much simpler if I could take it all.” ("अगर मैं यह सब ले सकता तो यह बहुत आसान होगा।")
